measurement: startupMs measures TUI process launch to connected home markers only (local backend already healthy); it excludes the subsequent acceptance workflow

workflowMeasurement.classification: deterministic packaged TUI acceptance with local mock-provider fixtures; not real-model coding success
workflowMeasurement.timing: End-to-end workflow wall time was not separately collected
workflowMeasurement.coverage: first-use provider connection and persisted reply; approved edit; delegation; independent child cancellation; graceful restart and SIGKILL recovery; terminal-size matrix

interactiveCoverage.journey: connected home -> seeded session -> Ctrl+R review -> approve workspace edit -> session composer

firstRunCoverage.classification: deterministic local fixture; not real-model coding success
firstRunCoverage.journey: clean profile -> packaged TUI /connect -> mock Ollama-compatible model discovery -> new session -> prompt -> persisted reply

delegationCoverage.classification: deterministic provider-fixture TUI smoke; not real-model coding success
delegationCoverage.journey: packaged TUI n creates session in isolated Git workspace -> /delegate -> choose explorer -> inherit route -> /agents status -> inspect result

cancellationCoverage.classification: deterministic provider-fixture TUI smoke; not real-model coding success

restartCoverage.journey: conversation persisted -> backend SIGINT/terminate -> restart on same data dir -> TUI reopen -> transcript + ready composer, no new prompt sent

killRecoveryCoverage.journey: async slow turn running -> backend SIGKILL mid-operation -> restart on same data dir -> operation uncertain with error, conversation unchanged

exclusions: Not render FPS, model/token latency, coding-task quality, or a cross-runner performance guarantee.
